════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
PROJECT: "DIKEJAR FACEBOOK — Geometry Dash Edition"
════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

CHECKPOINT MERGED REQUIREMENTS & ARCHITECTURE
Lokasi: d:\mngodof\geometridash

Ringkasan:
- HTML5 Canvas-based rhythm platformer (800×450px, scaled responsive).
- Player cube auto-runs, must jump to avoid obstacles.
- Facebook icon chases from left; ghost Facebook status posts taunt.
- Web Audio API synthesizes full EDM music (no external audio files).
- MODULAR architecture (separate JS files for each system).
- BGM files already downloaded: assets/audio/bgm/ (level1.mp3, level2.mp3, boss.mp3).

════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
MODULAR FILE STRUCTURE (as built)
════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

Core:
  - index.html (main entry, loads all scripts)
  - js/config.js (centralized CONFIG object with all tweakables)
  - js/main.js (game loop, state machine, integration)

Systems:
  - js/audio.js (Web Audio API synthesis + BGM playback)
  - js/particles.js (particle burst effects on hits)
  - js/background-animator.js (animated scanlines, floating elements)
  - js/visual-effects.js (vignette, danger flash, screen glitch, shake)
  - js/menu-animations.js (idle menu animations, button glow)
  - js/renderer.js (background, grid, clouds, static visuals)
  
Game Logic:
  - js/player.js (physics, jumping, collision box)
  - js/facebook.js (chaser AI, catch detection)
  - js/obstacle.js (spawn patterns, collision)
  - js/hud.js (score, level, danger indicator)
  - js/memeOverlay.js (ghost FB posts, random messages)

Assets:
  - assets/audio/bgm/ (level1.mp3, level2.mp3, boss.mp3)
  - assets/images/boss/ (folder for boss overlay screenshots)
  - assets/fonts/ (game fonts)
  - assets/images/ (player, enemy, obstacles, backgrounds)

════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
UNIFIED GAME SPEC (merged from requirements)
════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

LEVELS (4 total, with full color schemes):

Level 1 "STEREO MADNESS" [score 0–899]
  Colors: bg #040d28→#091640, primary #00d4ff, accent #0088ff
  Ground: #0d2045→#07112a, line #00d4ff
  Speed: 5.5px/frame, BPM: 140, interval: 90 frames, minInterval: 54
  Obstacles: #00ccff / #0055cc, Facebook: #4267B2

Level 2 "BACK ON TRACK" [score 900–2099]
  Colors: bg #180900→#2a1200, primary #ffaa00, accent #ff6600
  Ground: #361400→#1c0900, line #ffaa00
  Speed: 6.5, BPM: 145, interval: 75, minInterval: 44
  Obstacles: #ffaa00 / #ff4400, Facebook: #cc3300

Level 3 "POLARGEIST" [score 2100–3799]
  Colors: bg #0d0018→#190030, primary #cc44ff, accent #ff44cc
  Ground: #260040→#160020, line #cc44ff
  Speed: 7.8, BPM: 152, interval: 62, minInterval: 36
  Obstacles: #cc44ff / #8800ee, Facebook: #8800cc

Level 4 "DRY OUT" [score 3800+]
  Colors: bg #180000→#2a0000, primary #ff2244, accent #ff6644
  Ground: #380000→#1c0000, line #ff2244
  Speed: 9.2, BPM: 158, interval: 50, minInterval: 28
  Obstacles: #ff2244 / #ff5500, Facebook: #cc0000

PLAYER (36×36px):
  Position: fixed X=140px, Y snaps to ground (GROUND_Y = H - 66)
  Physics:
    - Gravity: +0.74 per frame
    - Jump: vy = -14.0 (on ground or coyote > 5 frames)
    - Rotation: in air += 0.10/frame; on ground lerp to 90° snap
  Visual:
    - Outer square (level primary color)
    - Inner dark square (rgba 0,0,0, 0.38) inset 5px
    - Center circle (accent color), radius = w×0.17 + beatFlash×2.5
    - 4 corner dots (white 0.6 alpha), radius 2.4px
    - Glow: shadowBlur = 18 + beatFlash×16
  Trail: rotated squares, life 1.0 → 0, decay 0.075/frame, alpha=life×0.42

FACEBOOK CHASER (46×46px):
  Position: x = -72 (starts off-left)
  Speed: level.speed × 0.62 + score × 0.0013
  Target: player.x - 95
  Wobble: sinusoidal ±5px at 0.14 rad/frame
  Visual:
    - Filled circle (level fbColor)
    - White bold "f" centered
    - ANGRY if dist < 170: body red, two red dots (eyes), eyebrows
  Catch: fb.x + 46 > player.x + 8 → game over

OBSTACLES (pattern-based spawn):
  Types: spike, block, tall, step, double-spike
  Level pools:
    Level 0 (easy): [sp], [sp,sp], [bl], [bl,sp], [sp,bl]
    Level 1 (medium): + [sp,sp,sp], [tl], [bl,bl], [st], [sp,tl], [tl,sp]
    Level 2 (hard): + [sp×4], [tl,tl], [st,sp], [sp,tl,sp], [double-sp]
    Level 3 (insane): + [tl,tl,sp], [sp,sp,sp,tl], [ds,tl], [st,tl,sp]
  Visual: canvas-drawn, glow blur = 11 + beatFlash×9

GHOST FEATURE (Facebook Status Post):
  Spawn interval: 300–700 frames (random)
  Fade speed: 0.018/frame, maxAlpha: 0.82, hold: 160 frames
  Bob: amplitude 6px, speed 0.025 rad/frame
  Card: 300×130px, rounded 12px, bg rgba(230,236,255, 0.12)
  Messages (random pick):
    - "ngapain ngoding, / mending scroll fesnuk 😂"
    - "deadline besok? / ya scroll aja dulu 😌"
    - "bug belum kelar? / fesnuk dulu 5 menit 🙃"
    - "ngoding dari tadi, / istirahat fesnuk yuk 😴"
    - "error mulu, / udah buka fesnuk aja bro 💀"

WEB AUDIO API ENGINE:
  BPM per level: 140, 145, 152, 158
  Schedule look-ahead: ~50ms interval, 150ms ahead
  Synth per bar:
    - KICK: sine 150→0.01Hz over 0.3s, gain 0.9→0
    - SNARE: lowpass noise on beats 2,4
    - HI-HAT: highpass noise (>7000Hz) every 8th note
    - BASS: sawtooth from array [55,55,82,55,65,55,82,110] per beat
    - LEAD: square from array [440,550,494,660,550,440,392,494] on upbeats
    - CHORD: 3 saws at bass × [1, 1.25, 1.5] on bar downbeat
  Beat flash: triggered on phase wrap; beatFlash decays by 0.045/frame
  Screen shake: 3.5px decays by 0.4/frame

HUD:
  Top bar: rgba(0,0,0, 0.38), height 46px
  Left: Score (bold 22px) + Level (12px primary)
  Center: Progress bar (240px, rounded, filled with primary)
  Right: "⚠ BAHAYA!" (red flicker) or "✔ AMAN" (#00ff88)

BACKGROUND:
  - Sky gradient (level bg colors)
  - Beat flash overlay (alpha = beatFlash × 0.07)
  - Stars (90 twinkling dots)
  - Geometric shapes (28 wireframe items, 2 parallax layers)
  - Ground gradient + glow line (shadowBlur = 10 + beatFlash×18)
  - Grid lines (primary color, 0.16 alpha, scrolling)

════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
QUICK START
════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

Run local server:
```powershell
cd d:\mngodof\geometridash
python -m http.server 8080
# Open http://127.0.0.1:8080 in browser
```

Verify:
  - Menu animations play on idle
  - Click "Mulai" or press Space
  - BGM starts (user interaction needed for audio unlock)
  - Play through levels, see particles on hit + danger effects
  - Console (F12) should be clean (no errors)

════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
NEXT TASKS (if continuing)
════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

1. Convert .webm → .mp3 with ffmpeg (optional but recommended):
```powershell
ffmpeg -i assets/audio/bgm/level1.webm -vn -ab 192k assets/audio/bgm/level1.mp3
ffmpeg -i assets/audio/bgm/level2.webm -vn -ab 192k assets/audio/bgm/level2.mp3
ffmpeg -i assets/audio/bgm/boss.webm -vn -ab 192k assets/audio/bgm/boss.mp3
```

2. Integrate boss screenshot overlay:
   - Add screenshot to: assets/images/boss/screenshot_boss.png
   - Hook into memeOverlay.js for level 4 activation

3. Expand Web Audio synthesis (optional):
   - Add dynamic EQ/filters per level
   - Add bass envelope modulation
   - Sync more visuals (scale, rotation) to synth parameters

4. Tweaks via CONFIG:
   - Adjust particle count, intensity, alpha
   - Tweak screen shake duration/intensity
   - Modify ghost message spawn rates
   - Balance obstacle difficulty per level

════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
NOTES
════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

- Modular design allows easy feature swaps and testing.
- Audio engine is initialized but integrated with BGM playback; optional synth synthesis can be added.
- All visuals are canvas-drawn (no image sprites for core gameplay).
- Responsive scaling: canvas 800×450 scales to fit viewport (max 1.6× scale).
- Browser autoplay policy requires user interaction to play audio (first click/tap unlocks AudioContext).
